result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: a failed restaurant image and an awkwardly clipped category item.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image has not loaded and is showing a large gray placeholder with a broken-image icon.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading logic and provide a polished fallback image or branded placeholder when loading fails.

issues.description: The category carousel ends with a partially visible blank pill on the right edge, which looks accidentally cropped and provides no readable context.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or the initial scroll position so the next category shows enough text to be recognizable, or hide the clipped item until it can be meaningfully displayed.
